input.script:
const projects = [
  {id: 'p1', dir: '/Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p1-voice-input', what: 'macOS desktop voice input app (Swift)'},
  {id: 'p2', dir: '/Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p2-multiplayer-web-game', what: 'multiplayer web game (Node server + browser client)'},
  {id: 'p3', dir: '/Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p3-plugin-harness', what: 'local AI agent plugin harness (CLI + local web dashboard)'},
  {id: 'p4', dir: '/Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p4-chrome-agent', what: 'Chrome Side Panel AI agent extension'},
  {id: 'p5', dir: '/Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p5-mcp-terminal', what: 'MCP terminal server'},
  {id: 'p6', dir: '/Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p6-p2p-chat', what: 'peer-to-peer end-to-end encrypted chat web app'},
  {id: 'p7', dir: '/Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p7-promo-video (may not exist) and /Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p7-promo-assets', what: 'promotional video for the other products'}
]
const schema = JSON.stringify({
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    id: {type: 'string'},
    product_type: {type: 'string'},
    acceptance_note_path: {type: 'string'},
    acceptance_note_ok: {type: 'boolean'},
    acceptance_note_gaps: {type: 'array', items: {type: 'string'}},
    packaged_artifacts: {type: 'array', items: {type: 'string'}},
    has_links_and_notes_section: {type: 'boolean'},
    published_urls: {type: 'array', items: {type: 'object', properties: {url: {type: 'string'}, http_status: {type: 'string'}}, required: ['url', 'http_status']}},
    needs_hosted_deployment: {type: 'boolean'},
    deployment_status: {type: 'string'},
    secrets_found: {type: 'boolean'},
    blockers: {type: 'array', items: {type: 'string'}},
    quick_fixes: {type: 'array', items: {type: 'string'}},
    verdict: {type: 'string', enum: ['ready', 'needs-work', 'blocked']},
    report_path: {type: 'string'}
  },
  required: ['id', 'product_type', 'acceptance_note_path', 'acceptance_note_ok', 'acceptance_note_gaps', 'packaged_artifacts', 'has_links_and_notes_section', 'published_urls', 'needs_hosted_deployment', 'deployment_status', 'secrets_found', 'blockers', 'quick_fixes', 'verdict', 'report_path']
})
const results = await parallel('Delivery audits of all seven projects', () => projects.map(p => agent(
  'You are auditing exactly one project for delivery readiness: ' + p.id + ', a ' + p.what + ', located at ' + p.dir + ' on this Mac.\n\n' +
  'STRICTLY READ-ONLY: do not modify, create, move or delete any file inside that project folder, do not run its build, install or package scripts, do not start long-running servers, and do not commit. Other people are working in these folders right now. You may read files, list zip contents, run `git -C <dir> log/status`, and use curl to check URLs. Finish within 8 minutes.\n\n' +
  'The delivery requirements are: (1) a short acceptance note explaining how to run and review the work; (2) extra information such as published URLs goes in a "Links and notes" section; (3) published URLs imply the product should be deployed somewhere a remote reviewer can access, where that makes sense for the product type. Web apps, games and chat apps need a hosted public URL. Desktop apps, CLIs, browser extensions and local tools need at least a downloadable package plus clear run instructions. Hard deadline for fixes: 18:15 local time today.\n\n' +
  'Check and report:\n' +
  '- Acceptance note: find it (README.md, outputs/README.md, DELIVERY.md or similar). Does it say how to install and run, how to review or verify, and what is known to be limited? List the gaps.\n' +
  '- Packaged artifacts in outputs/ or similar (zip, tgz, mp4). For each zip, list its contents with `unzip -l` and confirm no `.env`, `node_modules` or key files are inside. Check for leaked secrets by running `unzip -p <zip> | grep -c "sk-or-v1"` and `grep -rl "sk-or-v1" <outputs dir>`. Report only true or false, never print a secret.\n' +
  '- Published URLs: find every https URL recorded in the acceptance note, README, docs or a Links and notes section that claims to be a deployment or download. Check each with `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -L --max-time 10 <url>` and report the status code. Say whether a "Links and notes" section exists.\n' +
  '- Whether this product type needs a hosted deployment, and what its deployment status is (hosted and reachable / hosted but down / local only with download / nothing).\n' +
  '- Blockers, and a ranked list of quick fixes that the project owner could finish before 18:15. Estimate minutes for each.\n' +
  '- verdict: ready, needs-work or blocked.\n\n' +
  'Write a concise Markdown report (under 60 lines) to /Users/wesley/Documents/manus/p3-plugin-harness/.work/audit/' + p.id + '.md (create the .work/audit directory if needed; that is the only place you may write). Return that exact path in report_path, and return the structured fields.',
  {brief: 'Audit ' + p.id + ' delivery readiness (acceptance note, package, published URL)', schema: schema, effort_level: 'lite'}
)))
const ok = results.map((r, i) => r.ok ? r.value : null).filter(Boolean)
const failures = results.map((r, i) => r.ok ? null : {id: projects[i].id, code: r.error.code, message: r.error.message}).filter(Boolean)
return {audits: ok, failures: failures}
